description: Labelled USGS<->EMSC earthquake pairs for correlation calibration (G5). Ground truth: EMSC EventID service (itself a fuzzy misfit match) plus a hand-checked subset.

method.emsc_window: format=json, +-3600s, maxradius=1 deg around the USGS epicentre
method.hard_negative_rule: EMSC event != service match, |dt| <= 3600s and distance <= 100 km, closest-in-time 1 per USGS event, then the 35 smallest |dt| overall; hand-checked pairs always kept
caveats: The EventID service is a fuzzy misfit match (dloc/105 + dt/13 + dmag/0.8) tuned for M>4.5; MATCH labels from it are not independent ground truth.
NO_MATCH labels inferred from the service assume a one-to-one USGS<->EMSC mapping.
delta.dt_s = EMSC time - USGS time; delta.dmag = EMSC mag - USGS mag (magnitude types may differ).
